shorts_rules: Name the core subject and make the central topic clear within the first 3 seconds to prevent early drop-off.
Avoid dropping heavy technical jargon or data points in the first 5 seconds; establish the premise before introducing statistics.
Use a narrative problem-solution arc, systematically disproving or explaining alternatives before reaching the final engineering payoff.
Make abstract figures feelable by converting them into physical scales, everyday distances, or direct material comparisons.
Structure the sign-off with fresh, unique wording every time that naturally prompts a comment or response rather than relying on generic CTAs.
Keep the script tightly paced between 2.5 and 3.5 words per second to ensure clear articulation without dragging.
Build tension in the opening beats by combining visual shocks, surprising contradictions, or counter-intuitive premises.
visual_sound_notes: Pair voice-over narration with synchronized 3D animations or real tracking footage that matches every script beat instantly.
Use dynamic captions featuring mixed-case fonts, high-contrast keyword highlights, and minimal words per frame to sustain attention.
Maintain an active cut rate averaging between 1.5 and 3.5 cuts per 10 seconds to keep visual momentum steady without inducing fatigue.
Layer tense or curious ambient electronic background tracks underneath crisp, authoritative voiceovers paired with realistic mechanical and environmental sound effects.
summary_roman_urdu: Is mahine viral Shorts mein yeh baat samne aayi hai ke log high-stakes engineering, weird scientific anomalies, aur visual shocks ko sab se zyada pasand karte hain. Hamari pichhli videos mein ghalti yeh ho rahi thi ke hum shuru ke kuch seconds mein hi bohat zyaada technical ya heavy terms bol dete hain, jis ki wajah se 5 se 9 seconds ke darmiyan log video chhod kar chalay jaate hain. Hamein shuruat mein topic ko aasan aur hook-based rakhna hoga taake viewer ka interest ban jaye. Aakhri sign-off mein generic baatein karne ke bajaye koi aisa sawal ya fresh wording use karni chahiye jo comment section ko engage kare. Saath hi, titles aur topics ko aur zyada relatable aur catchy banana hoga taake impression se log click karne par majboor ho jayein.
